scope: Test a fixed statistic smoother and a slower step under the same four selected samples per window; only digital learner inputs.
step_contract: baseline uses EXP-032 steps; quarter_step divides every step by 4 without adding learner state; ema_quarter preserves baseline steps and filters selected sums with alpha=1/4
ema_integer_contract: 8 signed filter states H represent 4 times the raw-product statistic; H_next=nearest_even((3*H+4*P)/4); delta=nearest_even(-mu*30*2^22*H_next/(64*4)); filter and calibration state start at zero and unity respectively and remain continuous at sine transition
resource_contract: all methods select 4 samples at phase 0, score 120 outputs and commit once per window; EMA adds four 28-bit and four 24-bit filter registers (208 bits); filter intermediates need 30/26 bits; original 184-bit coefficient state is retained
evaluation: primary continued-online final integer-code MSE and approximate SNDR; frozen endpoint and prespecified checkpoints evaluate the same sine observations without choosing a best stop; report state ranges, actual target/error/filter-rounding attribution, clipping and per-window errors
candidate_support_criterion: each candidate separately: mean paired online SNDR gain over baseline > 0 dB, gains positive in at least 18/24 cells, MSE lower in at least 18/24 cells, and no paired SNDR loss exceeding 3 dB; finite screening only
failure_policy: retain all cells and failures; no parameter, seed, curve, horizon, phase or checkpoint replacement
limits: new parameters in two synthetic cubic families, three fresh seed groups and fixed tones per input; no chip, full convergence, unbiased Gu objective or target hardware cost claim
